title: Medical GAN Project: Multi-Disease Detection with GANs
summary: A medical imaging pipeline that trains DCGAN, WGAN-GP, and AC-GAN architectures for pneumonia, diabetic retinopathy, and melanoma image data augmentation and classification. It also uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to oversample minority-class tabular diabetic records for class imbalance correction.
